stated_question: Will a solar-powered cold locker keep Lisbon market produce fresh through a hot market day?

scqa.situation: Growers around Lisbon reach the market by mid-morning and the produce warms up before it sells.
scqa.complication: A solar-powered cold locker may fail on the days when it is needed most.
scqa.question: What must be true for a solar-powered cold locker to be enough for one stall for one day?

tension.statement: A cheap day rental versus an unseen failure on a cloudy day.

goal.target: Know which failures a solar cold locker cannot prevent.
goal.falsifier: evidence that the zone is already covered

limiters.label: Battery capacity through a cloudy winter day
limiters.question: Is the shortfall set by the battery size or by the compressor draw?
